key.name: start-hour
key.description: From this hour (0-23) the window starts appearing. If equal to the end hour, the window never appears.

key.name: end-hour
key.description: From this hour (0-23) the window stops appearing.

key.name: snooze-minutes
key.description: After being dismissed the window returns after this many minutes.

key.name: size-percent
key.description: Size of the card relative to the monitor size.

key.name: message
key.description: Text shown in the window. Empty means the built-in (translated) default.

key.name: esc-closes
key.description: When enabled, the Esc key closes the window like the "Yes" button. Off by default.

key.name: show-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that shows the question window immediately, regardless of the time.
